errors.error_description: Introduced a large constant multiply in the data path to compute debug_weighted, which can infer a costly multiplier instead of a simpler operation.
Mixed blocking (=) and non-blocking (<=) assignments within the same always_ff block by updating tap_accum with a blocking assignment while other registers use non-blocking assignments.
Created an unintended latch by incompletely assigning tap_hold in an always_comb block, only driving it when enable_tap is asserted without a default/else assignment.
